title: OLEANDER Systems Engineering Process v1.0
purpose: Run authentic system-of-interest engineering from lifecycle/authority basis through stakeholder needs, system requirements, architecture/allocation, technical decisions, element realization, system integration, verification, validation, transition and in-use lifecycle return while preserving configuration, domain-owner and R-F Integration boundaries.
scope_in: transition, operation, support, change and retirement readback
scope_out: automatic safety, security, statutory or licensed approval
automatic Design KEEP or Project Promotion
authority_position: Subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Architecture Map v2.1, Professional Domain Process Contract, Current Knowledge Authority, Shared Design Quality, R-F Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/system technical authority and applicable engineering, safety, security, regulatory and configuration owners.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim requires system-level professional judgment across multiple interacting technical, human, physical, software or organizational elements, system requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification, validation or lifecycle change.
responsibility_triggers: system-level claim depends on multiple elements/domains
stakeholder needs must trace to system requirements and acceptance evidence
system architecture/allocation or performance budgets control downstream work
critical interfaces or integration sequencing are configuration-dependent
verification and validation require system-level evidence
lifecycle/configuration change propagates across requirements, architecture or V&V
trigger.claim_ceiling_rule: The lowest valid boundary across SoI/configuration identity, authority, mounted evidence, requirement/architecture traceability, element/interface maturity, system V&V, specialist review and statutory authority governs the specific Systems Engineering claim.
not_triggered_when: a simple single-domain task has no material system-level traceability, architecture, integration or V&V claim
a requirements list is merely administrative and no Systems Engineering professional claim is made

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential requirements, architecture, interface, decision-analysis, modelling, V&V, reliability, safety, security, supplier and operational evidence must be admitted through task/claim-scoped Operational Mount before supporting a Systems Engineering decision.
required_methods: INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook Fifth Edition practice guidance
source_routes: INCOSE Systems Engineering Handbook Fifth Edition
applicable domain engineering, safety, security and regulatory sources
precedent_case_routes: bounded system precedents with explicit configuration, context and transfer limits
practice_routes: current OLEANDER systems-thinking and engineering practices
domain-specific engineering practices under their owners

stages.professional_question: What is the system-of-interest, lifecycle/configuration and authority boundary, and which Systems Engineering outcomes are actually required?
entry_conditions: material system-level trigger exists or applicability is being resolved
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Consequential authority/process/source claims require task/claim-scoped Operational Mount.
human_experience_consequences: human/operator/affected-party role is identified where part of the SoI
design_language_consequences: system form/representation cannot be frozen before SoI and lifecycle boundary are explicit
technical_consequences: configuration, enabling-system and process-tailoring assumptions become explicit
content_projection_requirements: state SoI, lifecycle, authority, tailoring and exclusions
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent Professional Domain review is required before Current process adoption and when governed project/system claims trigger it.
exit_conditions: SoI, lifecycle, configuration and responsibility boundary are explicit enough to develop needs

stages.professional_question: What do stakeholders and affected actors need the system to achieve, under which intended-use conditions and success measures?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Methods structure evidence but do not manufacture stakeholder needs.
interface_requirements: HCD/Human Factors where human use is material
human_experience_consequences: operator/user/affected-person needs and high-consequence failures become explicit where applicable
design_language_consequences: system concept must later respond to intended use rather than abstract decomposition alone
technical_consequences: mission/use states, measures and constraints feed requirement engineering
content_projection_requirements: separate stakeholder need, engineering interpretation and unresolved conflict
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for adoption- or mission-critical stakeholder-need claims when triggered.
exit_conditions: material stakeholder needs/intended-use claims are evidence-bound and conflicts explicit
reopen_triggers: stakeholder, mission, operational context or authority changes

stages.professional_question: What verifiable system requirements correctly translate authorized needs and constraints for the declared SoI/configuration?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Requirement values/criteria derived from external standards or domain evidence require current applicable mounts.
human_experience_consequences: human-facing system requirements remain traceable to intended-use needs where applicable
design_language_consequences: none may substitute for explicit requirements/architecture relations
technical_consequences: requirements gain IDs, conditions, measures, allocation/verification routes and change impact
content_projection_requirements: do not present a requirement list as validated system truth
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent requirements review required where project/system policy or criticality triggers it.
exit_conditions: consequential requirements are uniquely identified, traceable and sufficiently verifiable for architecture work
reopen_triggers: need, authority, requirement, criterion or SoI/configuration change

stages.professional_question: What arrangement of elements, functions, behaviours and interfaces can satisfy the current system requirements with acceptable lifecycle consequences?
entry_conditions: system requirements are sufficiently defined for architecture alternatives
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Reference architectures and model assumptions require bounded applicability; they do not become project truth by reuse.
human_experience_consequences: human-system allocation and operational consequences are explicit where applicable
design_language_consequences: system representation must preserve functional/physical/state relations rather than decorative diagramming
technical_consequences: requirements are allocated; interfaces and budgets become controlled engineering objects
content_projection_requirements: show alternatives, assumptions, rejected options and allocation boundaries
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent architecture review required for Current/adoption-critical system-architecture claims when triggered.
exit_conditions: selected architecture/allocation is rationale-bound and material interfaces/budgets are identified
reopen_triggers: requirement, element, interface, budget or major trade-study evidence changes

stages.professional_question: Which system-level decisions are sufficiently evidenced, and what uncertainty/risk remains before commitment?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Decision evidence and external criteria require applicable mounts; scoring method cannot manufacture authority.
human_experience_consequences: human/operational consequences enter criteria when material
design_language_consequences: none; decision visualization must not hide uncertainty or near-equivalent alternatives
technical_consequences: selected alternatives, sensitivity and technical-performance implications become traceable
content_projection_requirements: preserve alternatives, criteria, uncertainty/sensitivity and decision authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent review required for consequential system decisions when owner policy/criticality triggers it.
exit_conditions: decision has accountable authority, evidence, uncertainty and reopen boundary
reopen_triggers: alternative feasibility, criteria, evidence, risk or authority changes

stages.professional_question: Are system elements being realized/acquired/supplied against controlled requirements, interfaces and configuration assumptions?
entry_conditions: architecture/allocation and element responsibilities are sufficiently defined
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Supplier/product/domain evidence requires exact identity/applicability and does not transfer professional authority to SE.
human_experience_consequences: human-facing element consequences remain assigned to HCD/Human Factors owners where applicable
design_language_consequences: none; representation does not substitute for realized element evidence
technical_consequences: exact element identity, allocated requirement evidence, deviations and readiness become explicit
content_projection_requirements: separate supplier claim, element-owner PASS and system readiness
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review remains owner-native for element evidence and system-level readiness when triggered.
open_items_allowed: bounded element issues that explicitly block/hold dependent integration claims
exit_conditions: integration prerequisites are resolvable and unresolved element issues cannot silently advance

stages.professional_question: Can controlled system elements be assembled/configured into the intended system increment without unresolved critical interface contradictions?
entry_conditions: integration prerequisites and configuration identities are sufficiently resolved
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Integration method/tool evidence cannot substitute for actual assembled/configured readback.
human_experience_consequences: human-system interfaces are integrated against HCD/Human Factors requirements where triggered
design_language_consequences: none; integration evidence must remain system/configuration-bound
technical_consequences: actual interface behaviour and assembled configuration become evidence-bound
content_projection_requirements: distinguish SE integration activity from R-F interface maturity/disposition
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/system integration review required where consequential close/adoption is claimed and triggered.
open_items_allowed: explicit non-critical anomalies inside claim ceiling
exit_conditions: system increment/configuration exists with material interface anomalies dispositioned or blocking

stages.professional_question: Does the exact controlled system/configuration satisfy specified system requirements at the appropriate verification level?
entry_conditions: requirements and exact verification configuration are controlled
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Criteria, models, instruments and procedures require current applicable evidence and identity.
interface_requirements: R-F where interface requirement is verified
human_experience_consequences: human-facing requirement verification remains distinct from intended-use validation
technical_consequences: specified requirement claims bind exact method, configuration, criterion and actual result
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent technical/professional verification review remains separate and is required when triggered.
open_items_allowed: requirements explicitly not yet verified and excluded from current claim
exit_conditions: asserted requirement-verification claims have actual evidence-bound dispositions

stages.professional_question: Does the realized or representative system satisfy stakeholder needs and intended use in the relevant operational context?
entry_conditions: validation needs/use claims and exact representative system/configuration are defined
knowledge_inputs: HCD/Human Factors routes where people are material
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Validation methods/context claims require applicable evidence; simulation limits remain explicit.
human_experience_consequences: representative operators/users and operational scenarios are included where relevant
technical_consequences: intended-use claims are tested against representative system/context with explicit transfer limits
content_projection_requirements: do not collapse simulation, pilot and field validation into one truth state
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent validation review required for consequential system acceptance/adoption claims when triggered.
open_items_allowed: explicit unvalidated contexts outside current claim ceiling
exit_conditions: asserted intended-use/stakeholder claims have representative evidence-bound dispositions

stages.professional_question: Can the verified/validated system increment be transferred into intended operation/support without losing controlled configuration, capability or evidence?
entry_conditions: system increment has sufficient verification/validation evidence for the transition claim
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Transition criteria and operational constraints require current context evidence.
human_experience_consequences: operator/maintainer readiness and training are included where material
technical_consequences: as-deployed configuration and transition deviations become traceable
content_projection_requirements: separate transition evidence from release/statutory authority
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist transition review required where owner policy/criticality triggers it.
open_items_allowed: bounded operational monitoring items inside declared transition claim
exit_conditions: transition claim is supported by actual as-deployed/readiness evidence and open limits are explicit

stages.professional_question: What does actual system use reveal about requirements, architecture, interfaces, support assumptions and lifecycle decisions?
stages.knowledge_mount_requirement: Reusable lessons remain candidate routes and cannot bypass Knowledge/Evolution validation.
human_experience_consequences: operator/user/affected-person evidence is routed to appropriate HCD/Human Factors owners where material
technical_consequences: actual performance, incidents, support demand and configuration changes can reopen affected system claims
content_projection_requirements: separate observed outcome, causal hypothesis, uncertainty, repair/retest and transfer boundary
stages.independent_review_requirement: Independent/specialist review required when in-use evidence supports consequential system, safety, security or adoption claims.
exit_conditions: material project/system failures are reopened/resolved and reusable lessons remain bounded candidates
reopen_triggers: new operational evidence, configuration, requirement, environment or authority changes

controlling_authority_requirements: SE does not self-award statutory/safety/security authority
interface_contract.interface_maturity_policy: Synchronize by required system/interface information and maturity, never by matching stage/process numbers.
allowed_open_interface_conditions: explicit bounded OPEN interfaces inside current claim ceiling
OUTSIDE_CLAIM interface with owner and consequence recorded
integration_readback_requirements: reopen affected system claims when consumed interface changes

native_source_of_truth_rules: exact SoI/configuration identity binds all consequential evidence
native engineering/test source controls over screenshots/summaries
model result is bounded by model purpose/assumptions/validation
execution_owner_requirements: Systems Engineering owner runs system-level process
element/domain engineering remains with its professional owner
tool_adapter_requirements: requirements/MBSE/test/configuration tools preserve stable IDs and provenance
automation cannot manufacture professional acceptance or physical truth
actual_readback_requirements: bind verification/validation to exact requirement/need and configuration

assurance.professional_review: Systems Engineering owner reviews system-level needs, requirements, architecture, decisions, integration, V&V and lifecycle evidence within scope.
assurance.evidence_review: Evidence/truth review remains separate and preserves exact configuration, method, criterion, result, uncertainty and provenance.
assurance.independent_review: Independent Professional Domain review binds exact reviewed input under Current §34; different tool/session is not independence.
assurance.receipt_contract: Professional completion requires owner-native receipt/readback; machine/schema/CI success cannot award professional verdict.

stale_scope_rules: chronology alone does not globally invalidate system evidence
upstream_impact_rules: changed intended use may reopen needs and requirements
changed authority/SoI may reopen dependent system claims
downstream_impact_rules: changed requirement can stale affected allocation/elements/interfaces/V&V
changed architecture/configuration can stale affected integration/V&V
interface_reopen_rules: material R-F interface change reopens only consuming system claims and dependent evidence
receipt_stale_rules: historical receipts remain immutable under exact consumed system/configuration/authority snapshot
current consumption requires re-resolution when relevant configuration/fingerprint/review input changes

process_exit_conditions: critical interfaces have required R-F disposition
open_items_allowed: bounded non-critical items inside explicit claim ceiling
future lifecycle monitoring outside current claim
completion_contract.professional_receipt: Owner-native Systems Engineering professional receipt bound to exact SoI/configuration/requirements/architecture/V&V/review input.
completion_contract.promotion_effect: Systems Engineering process completion does not itself adopt this reusable process, grant Project Promotion, or mutate Current architecture authority.
completion_contract.claim_ceiling: Only exact SoI/configuration/requirements/architecture/interfaces/V&V/lifecycle scope actually read back.
